newsitem.title: USA: Anacomp names Ralph Koehrer President/COO.
newsitem.headline: Anacomp names Ralph Koehrer President/COO.

text.p: Anacomp Inc said Wednesday it appointed Ralph Koehrer as president and chief operating officer.

Koehrer, 51, will assume responsibility for the day-to-day operations of all of Anacomp's businesses except Magnetics, which remains a separate unit. For the past year, P. Lang Lowrey, 43, Anacomp's chairman and chief executive officer, has been performing these duties in addition to his other responsibilities. Koehrer will join Anacomp on January 6, 1997 and will be based at the company's Poway, California facility.

Koehrer comes to Anacomp from Automatic Data Processing, Inc, where he has served as a corporate officer and as president of ADP's Information & Processing Services division, which provides front- and back-office services to major Wall Street brokerage firms. He led ADP's effort to introduce new technology into its brokerage processing service bureaus, and he transformed the focus of its financial information services business from proprietary hardware systems to software.
